badges.direction: At SUNRISE beside a large east-facing window, viewed from a HIGH RIGHT THREE-QUARTER angle. A big warm COFFEE CUP occupies the central foreground. Folha's book body folds gently FORWARD AROUND the cup like a sleepy hug, almost closing around its warmth: indigo back cover edges clearly visible on either side, cream face bent over the steam, graduation cap drooping askew. BOTH hands wrap around the sides of the same cup, close together, no other hand action. Mouth wide in a genuine YAWN, heavy eyelids and lifted sleepy brows; this is tender and drowsy, NOT a cheerful upright smile. A pink-peach sun clears the horizon outside, golden steam curls in cool morning light. Cup rests on desk, book floats at cup level with no lower appendages. No clock digits or letters. Preserve a recognizably OPEN BOOK with two broad INNER page planes and center gutter; tilt the whole book toward cup as one coherent object, do NOT bend a page block into a human torso.
badges.prompt:
Fill ONLY the CENTRAL TRANSPARENT WINDOW of IMAGE 1 with ONE new Estudário achievement story. IMAGE 1 is the FIXED AUREOLA/TIER FRAME TARGET: its rings, exact shape, branches, gemstone positions, cap crest, empty indigo ribbon, materials, thickness, scale and framing must remain UNCHANGED. Do not redraw, redesign, add/remove ornaments, shift or recolor the frame. Exterior and small wreath gaps remain genuine alpha transparency; only the CENTRAL HOLE receives the new painted scene. Fit every scene element behind the frame and ribbon. IMAGE 2 is the approved Collection II plano-200 STYLE AND OPEN-BOOK IDENTITY reference: luxurious dip-pen ink, layered gouache, colored-pencil grain, warm narrative light, indigo hardcover/cap, cream pages and mint bookmark. Its pose must NOT be copied. IMAGE 3 is the official Folha anatomy guide, ONLY for the physical layering and arm roots, not its flat vector style.

CRITICAL PHYSICAL BOOK: Folha is a genuinely OPEN HARDCOVER BOOK with TWO broad cream INNER PAGE SURFACES forming a shallow V and a clear CENTER GUTTER. Eyes, brows, cheeks and mouth belong on those INNER PAGE PLANES. Indigo hardcover is behind both page blocks, with only THIN stacked paper edges around the perimeter. NEVER put a face on the fore-edge/paper thickness, closed book block, indigo back cover, phone/tablet shape, human torso or neck. The cap sits above the gutter, mint bookmark drapes naturally. Rotate/tilt the complete book coherently for each pose. For a rear view show TWO indigo rear cover panels and their spine forming a V; the face is hidden or only visible on an actual INNER PAGE plane, never on edges.

MOST IMPORTANT — ARMS BEHIND THE COVER:
Exactly TWO thin INDIGO cartoon arm curves, one rooted at MID-HEIGHT BEHIND each opposite outer side of the REAR HARDCOVER, like image 3.
Draw arm roots in the BACK LAYER, then the complete hardcover and paper blocks IN FRONT. Thus the book visibly OCCLUDES/HIDES the roots. Only the arm segments OUTSIDE the book silhouette are visible.
NEVER stick an arm socket onto a broad cream page plane, broad rear-cover plane, top edge near cap, bottom edge or spine. No shoulders. No gold cuffs/sockets at roots. No hand growing out of a page.
Arm thickness roughly 4 percent of book width, simple smooth indigo curves without realistic muscles or fleshy forearms. Hands small soft cream mittens about 9–11 percent of book width, grouped rounded fingers and a thumb, no long splayed/interlaced realistic fingers.
Let the cover naturally hide a far-side limb segment when needed; do not invent an extra visible root to show it. Two hands total, correctly connected to those two arms. Bring held objects within plausible reach; simplify a gesture if necessary while keeping the distinctive pose and story. NO LEGS, FEET, KNEES, SHOES, SOCKS, human lower body or supports below book.

Blank papers may have abstract highlight strokes, simple pictograms or grading cross/check pictograms if requested. The fabric ribbon stays fully EMPTY. Output one complete transparent badge only, not a sheet. The following scene must have its OWN camera, body orientation, action, scale and expression, different from the reference portrait.

BOTH hands wrap around the sides of the same cup, close together, no other hand action. Mouth wide in a genuine YAWN, heavy eyelids and lifted sleepy brows; this is tender and drowsy, NOT a cheerful upright smile. A pink-peach sun clears the horizon outside, golden steam curls in cool morning light. Cup rests on desk, book floats at cup level with no lower appendages. No clock digits or letters. Preserve a recognizably OPEN BOOK with two broad INNER page planes and center gutter; tilt the whole book toward cup as one coherent object, do NOT bend a page block into a human torso.
FINAL ANATOMY CHECK BEFORE OUTPUT: Reference 4 shows the correct PAINTED book construction and arm occlusion. Match its layering, not its pose. An arm must disappear BEHIND the cover's OUTER CONTOUR; never terminate in a visible rounded stump or socket painted on any book surface. Paint the cover ON TOP of the roots. A root visible on the cover/page plane is a FAILURE. Keep BOTH page surfaces of open-book views coherent; rear views show two rear covers and no face on paper thickness.

badges.name: Coruja
badges.story: Sob a luminária e o céu estrelado, o Folha estuda com uma coruja pousada no capelo.
badges.pose: De bruços quase na horizontal, queixo apoiado nas mãos e olhos voltados para a coruja.
badges.direction: A nocturnal overhead-oblique view of a desk by a STAR-FILLED night window. Folha lies PRONE almost flat across the desk, open book-face lifted only at its TOP EDGE, body receding diagonally AWAY from camera; its chin rests on BOTH HANDS, elbows planted close together on a separate open study notebook. Its eyes look UP sideways toward a SMALL OWL perched on the tilted graduation cap; a wry tired-but-amused small smile, one eyebrow raised. The owl's claws grip only the cap brim and it looks attentively back; bird legs are natural, Folha has NONE. A curved TABLE LAMP on the right creates a focused pool of warm light on the cream notebook, deep midnight indigo and stars beyond. Show the distinct prone, chin-in-hands pose, NOT a front-facing upright book, not a reclined cheek-on-one-hand pose. No text, no clock digits.
